# The Hosteller

> > India's leading backpacker hostel chain offering budget accommodations across Himalayan destinations, cultural hubs, and adventure travel hotspots.

The Hosteller operates hostels throughout India in destinations like Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Kerala, Coorg, and major cities, catering to backpackers and adventure travelers. The site features travel guides, trekking routes, festival coverage, and destination information across the Himalayas and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Backpacker hostels
- Himachal Pradesh destinations
- Trekking and adventure travel
- Great Himalayan National Park
- Tirthan Valley
- Weekend getaways from Delhi and Mumbai
- Kerala culture and festivals
- Uttarakhand hill stations
- Maharashtra tourism
- Pet-friendly accommodations
- Group bookings
- Monsoon travel
- Old Delhi food tours
- Coorg coffee plantations
- India travel guides
